Title: Suresh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Suresh - 32 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Neeta - 32 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Anita - 59 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Suresh stands by the road. Anita and Neeta stand near him.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Suresh rides his motorbike to the market.]

Suresh: "That's great!"

[Suresh starts his scooter and rides off.]

Suresh (gently): "Really?"

[Suresh gets out of the car.]

Suresh: "What happened?"

[Suresh takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Suresh (softly): "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Suresh stands on the road. Anita stands near him.]

Suresh: "Let's begin."

[Suresh starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Suresh: "I knew it!"

[Suresh is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Suresh: "That was fun!"

[Suresh steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Suresh: "Let's see."

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

[Neeta stands on the terrace. Anita and Suresh stand near her.]

Suresh: "Neeta, look over here."

[Neeta hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Neeta: "Yes, of course."

Scene 4: The living room - Day

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Suresh sips red wine.]

Anita (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Suresh drinks a beer.]

Suresh: "I knew it!"

[Suresh staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Anita: "Well done!"

[Suresh and Mother clink their glasses.]

Suresh: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
